description: Repository structure, hygiene, and git baseline. Create directory structure (.kiro/, .github/, docs/, scripts/, config/), complete .gitignore, .editorconfig, LICENSE (MIT), tag prototype-v0, create phase/0-foundation branch. This establishes the foundation for all subsequent work.
steps: Tag current HEAD as 'prototype-v0' using: cd /mnt/d/3rd\ year/os\ project/IntelliShell && git tag prototype-v0
Create directory structure: mkdir -p .kiro/steering .kiro/specs/phase-0-foundation .github/workflows docs/adr scripts config

Update .gitignore to include: target/, __pycache__/, .venv/, node_modules/, dist/, .env, config/local.env, *.log, .ruff_cache/, .pytest_cache/, *.pyc, .DS_Store, uv.lock should NOT be ignored (it gets committed)

Create .editorconfig with standard rules: root=true, [*] indent_style=space, indent_size=2, end_of_line=lf, charset=utf-8, trim_trailing_whitespace=true, insert_final_newline=true, [*.{rs,toml}] indent_size=4, [*.md] trim_trailing_whitespace=false, [Makefile] indent_style=tab
Create LICENSE file with MIT license, copyright holder: IntelliShell Contributors
Commit: git add .gitignore .editorconfig LICENSE && git commit -m 'chore: repository structure and hygiene'
acceptance_criteria: Tag prototype-v0 exists: git tag -l | grep prototype-v0
Branch phase/0-foundation exists and is checked out: git branch --show-current returns phase/0-foundation
All directories exist: test -d .kiro/steering && test -d .github/workflows && test -d docs/adr && test -d scripts && test -d config
.editorconfig and LICENSE files exist and have correct content
findings: Successfully created repository structure with all required directories (.kiro/, .github/, docs/, scripts/, config/). Tagged prototype-v0 and created phase/0-foundation branch. Updated .gitignore with all required patterns including target/, __pycache__/, node_modules/, .env, config/local.env, *.log, .ruff_cache/, .pytest_cache/. Created .editorconfig with proper rules for all file types and LICENSE with MIT license. All verification checks pass.
